summary: Claude passed this scenario. It loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, read NOTES.md, the activity page files and all four UI guideline docs, and went through an auto-compaction ("Compacting conversation…", then "Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)"). After that, with no hint from me, it ran scripts/start-server.sh and wrote filter-placement.html showing three layouts. It gave me a localhost URL with a key and announced the task as bounded with the design kept in chat. I picked A (filter bar above the table). It then asked three implementation-scope questions, posted a short design in chat and asked "Should I go ahead and build this?". I said yes and it started implementation research. No spec or plan file was created.
reasoning: All 8 criteria are backed by the session log, files on disk and screen text. The agent decided on its own that the layout question should be shown rather than described, opened the companion only when that question came up, kept the task bounded with no spec or plan, asked for approval, and started implementation after I approved.

observations.description: After I picked a layout, the agent asked three more AskUserQuestion prompts (token source, which filters, scope of unrelated CSS/no-JS fixes) before posting its design for approval. That is defensible, but it adds several round-trips to a bounded task.
The agent offered to fix unrelated existing problems (raw hex values in activity.css) as its 'Recommended' option. That is scope creep beyond 'narrow down the table'. I chose 'Leave both'.

The companion files were written under .hyperpowers/ in the repo root, which leaves an untracked directory behind (git status: '?? .hyperpowers/'). The agent did point this out and suggested adding a .gitignore.
The agent noted on its own that 'The browser sketches use a lot of tokens'. That is a good disclosure, but the cost is worth watching.

Setup oddity, not related to the product under test: at startup Claude Code showed a 'Newer Opus model available' prompt even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No and the banner then showed Opus 5.5.

The auto-compaction this scenario targets did happen right after the agent read visual-companion.md ('Compacting conversation…', 'Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)'). The companion still opened correctly afterwards.
